headerDescription: A fullstack developer with a passion for web development.
aboutText: I'm a Brazilian developer with a deep passion for coding, and most of what I know comes from rolling up my sleeves and diving into projects. I'm currently enrolled in an Internet Systems course at FATEC Rubens Lara, but I've spent a lot of time teaching myself the ins and outs of web development, especially with React, TailwindCSS, and Node.js. I love creating sleek, functional web apps and am always eager to learn more and tackle new challenges in the tech world. If you’d like to learn more about me, feel free to reach out or download my resume!

habit-tracker.description: A full-stack habit tracking app built with Next.js and React 19. Track daily habits, visualize your progress over time, and maintain streaks to build consistent routines.

architetando.description: Landing page created for the Achitetando architecture studio.

product-radar.description: A modern web interface for the intelligent analysis of e-commerce products. Automatically analyze product reviews and ratings from Amazon and Mercado Livre using artificial intelligence.

esc-site.description: Landing page created for the ESC rock band.

languages.intro: A mix of what I use daily — JavaScript and TypeScript — and languages picked up through coursework or on my own, like Java, C#, and C++.

frameworks.intro: React and Node.js anchor most of what I build, with TailwindCSS handling styling in nearly every frontend project. Spring Boot and Styled Components round things out from coursework and side projects.

databases.intro: PostgreSQL and Prisma are my go-to pairing for most projects, with MongoDB in the mix from an earlier course.

tools.intro: Git and Docker are steady parts of how I work, alongside Railway for deployment and Claude as part of my actual development process.
